description: 國際及兩岸定期班機航線-客運(年資料) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 民用航空局. 國際及兩岸客運定期班機各航線資料(每週飛行次數、航線里程). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 民用航空局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
